elsewhere.note: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw…
